completion_rule: Complete requires the player workflow, adverse cases, native regression, persistent state, browser controls and matching API/MCP documentation. A foundation is partial.

items.name: Save and reuse designs

items.name: Leave and return

items.evidence: Startup additions retain running bodies, connections, machine state and water under strict staged comparison, with durable no-refill receipts. Complete heater/gas and broader fluid persistence remains.

items.acceptance: Isolated native experiments now available; distinguish externally supplied initial conditions from physical manufacture

Fabrication explicitly distinguishes seeded resources from charged work and native outputs. See docs/physics-trials.md and docs/fabrication.md.
